centring.datum: paired stadium stand fronts / roof opening; excludes annexes

google_overhead_review.review: Replaced the exaggerated bowed parallel truss ribbons with a restrained four-sided principal support frame connected to the four corner masts. The two overheads show different elevation/parallax separation of the truss chords, so the drawing uses reduced plan axes, not their shadows or elevation bows. Oval canopy and pitch scale are retained.
google_overhead_review.imagery_capture_date: Unknown; acquisition date is not photograph date.
google_overhead_review.comparison_frame: 400 by 340 ground metres; retained geographic field datum and long axis; no fit-to-page scaling.
google_overhead_review.limitations: Visually reviewed simplified main features, not a measured as-built survey or every roof panel. Elevated roofs can be displaced by parallax. Some views show older redevelopment stages; see individual review.
google_overhead_review.usage: Private comparison only. Original Google screenshots retain attribution. No reference bitmap is embedded in plot artwork; this is not a licence to redistribute imagery.
